Effects of drug interactions on in vivo exposure of mycophenolic acid in renal transplant recipients
ZHANG Han － juan1 ， DING Jian － qiang2 ， HAN Wan － chao1 ， CHEN Yong － yan1 ，DING Rui1 ， WANG Gao － biao1 ， LI Xue1 Abstract：Objective This study analyzes the effect of concomitant medication on the in vivo exposure of mycophenolic acid in patients with renal transplantation， and it provide reference for the rational clinical application of mycophenolate mofetil （ MMF） ． Methods A retrospective study method was used to summarize the information of inpatients treated with MMF and measured their concentrations in the renal transplantation department of Zhengzhou No． 7 People’ s Hospital． The impact on the exposure of mycophenolic acid were analyzed and discussed from the concentration distribution， the effects of gastric acid secretion － inhibiting drugs， antiviral drugs， and CNI drugs．Results The $\mathrm { A U C } _ { 0 \sim 1 2 \mathrm { ~ h ~ } }$ of mycophenolic acid in the range of $3 0 \mathrm { ~ - ~ } 6 0 ~ \mu \mathrm { g } \left( \mathrm { ~ h / m L } \right)$ accounted for 58. 39％ ； The trough concentration was positively correlated with the $\mathrm { A U C } _ { 0 \sim 1 2 \mathrm { ~ h ~ } }$ of mycophenolic acid （ r ＝ 0. 804， P ＝ 0. 000 ） ； Combination of drugs that inhibit gastric acid secretion has no significant effect on mycophenolic acid $\mathrm { A U C } _ { 0 \sim 1 2 \mathrm { ~ h ~ } } ;$ Ganciclovir can reduce mycophenolic acid $\mathrm { A U C } _ { 0 \sim 1 2 \mathrm { ~ h ~ } } ( \textit { U } = 1 2 9 3 6 . 5$ ， Z ＝ － 2. 442， $P = 0 . 0 1 5 )$ ； The $\mathrm { A U C } _ { 0 \sim 1 2 \mathrm { ~ h ~ } }$ of mycophenolic acid in the crolimus group was significantly higher than that of the combined cyclosporine group （ U ＝ 3916. 0， Z ＝ － 4. 698， P ＜ 0. 001 ） ． Conclusion There is a certain correlation between the exposure of mycophenolic acid in vivo and the trough concentration， but it cannot be estimated by the trough concentration； the combination of drugs that inhibit gastric acid secretion does not affect the in vivo exposure of mycophenolic acid； the combination of ganciclovir reduces the vivo exposure of mycophenolic acid； there are differences in the in vivo exposure of mycophenolic acid in different anti － rejection regimens．Keywords：Vivo exposure of mycophenolic acid； Ganciclovir； Proton pump inhibitor； Tacrolimus在器官移植中广泛应用［1 － 2］。 口服后在胃肠道充分吸收被血浆和组织中的酯酶迅速水解为活性成分—霉酚酸（MPA）。 霉酚酸血药浓度在不同患者中个体差异大，为更好地控制免疫排斥反应、减少药品不良反应发生，临床推荐 $\mathrm { A U C } _ { 0 \sim 1 2 \mathrm { ~ h ~ } }$ 曲线下面积 $\mathrm { A U C } _ { 0 \sim 1 2 \mathrm { ~ h ~ } } )$ 作为 MMF 的治疗药物监测（ ther⁃指标［3］ 称为霉酚酸体内暴露量霉酚酸体内暴露量个体间差异性较大，其原因主要与患者的自身生理因素以及药物相互作用有关［4 － 6］。 本文重点分析药物相互作用对霉酚酸体内暴露量的影响。 器官移植术后用药较为复杂，有文献报道 MPA 与很多药物存在相互作用但是有具体研究数据的报道甚少抑制胃酸分泌药物是器官移植术后预防应激性溃疡的常用药物；抗病毒药物特别是更昔洛韦，是器官移植术后预防巨细胞病毒感染的主要药物；钙调磷酸酶抑制剂（CNI）是术后重要的抗排斥药物，本研究回顾性分析 435 例次患者 $\mathrm { A U C } _ { 0 \sim 1 2 \mathrm { ~ h ~ } }$ 监测结果及其临床资料，详细考察这三类药物对肾移植患者术后霉酚酸体内暴露量的影响为临床合理使用霉酚酸酯提供必要依据。
